# SoifGo

> SoifGo is a free, open-source Android app that turns your phone into a custom hardware controller for Arduino, ESP32, ESP8266, HC-05, and Raspberry Pi. It supports Bluetooth SPP, MQTT, HTTP/REST, HTML/JavaScript WebView, microphone and speech recognition, and phone sensors (light, accelerometer X and Y, magnetometer Z). The HTML/WebView bridge is exposed via `window.soifgo.CallSub()`.

## AI-Ready Reference

- [AI Context (Markdown)](https://soifgo.github.io/soifgo/SOIFGO_AI_CONTEXT.md): Complete AI reference. Covers the bridge, Bluetooth send and receive, sensors, microphone permission, MQTT, API, storage, known limitations, and common mistakes. Load this file first when answering questions about SoifGo.
- [HTML + Bluetooth + Sensors Tutorial](https://soifgo.github.io/soifgo/tutorials/send_bluetooth_html/html_guide_1.html): Official tutorial containing the real Sub API and working code examples.
- [Voice → Serial Bluetooth Tutorial](https://soifgo.github.io/soifgo/tutorials/serial_voice/serial_voice_tutorials.html): Microphone permission, speech recognition, 22 languages, and voice-to-Bluetooth pipeline.

## Quick Facts for AI Assistants

- **Bridge namespace:** `window.soifgo`
- **Bridge method:** `window.soifgo.CallSub(subName, hasReturn, ...args)`
- **Return flag:** Always `true` for SoifGo subs. The second argument is required.
- **Arguments:** Up to 3 after the boolean. Empty strings must be passed as `''`, not omitted.
- **Send to Bluetooth:** `window.soifgo.CallSub('html_bluetooth_rx', true, TEXT)`
- **Receive from Bluetooth:** define `function html_bluetooth_tx(data) { }` and attach with `window.html_bluetooth_tx = html_bluetooth_tx;`
- **Sensors:** activate with `window.soifgo.CallSub('sensor_light', true)`, `'sensor_move'`, `'sensor_magno'`
- **Sensor callbacks:** `html_sensor_light(data)`, `html_sensor_movex(data)`, `html_sensor_movey(data)`, `html_sensor_magno(data)` — all must be attached to `window.*`
- **Sensor data format:** All values arrive as strings. Light is integer. Accelerometer X and Y have 3 decimals. Magnetometer Z has 2 decimals.
- **Sensor limitations:** Accelerometer Z is NOT forwarded. Magnetometer X and Y are NOT forwarded. A 3-axis compass or 3-axis spirit level cannot be built inside the WebView.
- **Microphone:** call `window.soifgo.CallSub('request_mic_perm', true, null)` once before using `getUserMedia` or `SpeechRecognition`.
- **MQTT status:** arrives as a string `'true'` or `'false'`, not a boolean.
- **API response:** may be a plain value (`86846.51`) or a B4A Map string (`{usd=86750}`). Handle both.
- **Availability:** `window.soifgo` only exists inside SoifGo's WebView. Always guard with `if (window.soifgo) { ... }`.
- **Critical:** Do NOT invent function names. Use only the exact names in the AI Context file.
